ctx.x: Well, my first wife. I met her in Florida. I was at 'Bama State then and we used to tour Florida for the school. And, she was, she was out of school She had finished.

Bethune, she went to Bethune-Cookman College. And, at the time when I met her, I was going to a show and she was cashier during that summer and I met her. Then, I invited her to a dance, you know, just to meet her. So, she came, and we got to be friends then. And then, that summer, she happened had a vacation and came to New York. That was on her vacation before going back to teaching. So, she found out, she decided that she didn't want to go back. So, we finally got married. That was in '35. I think I was 21…

So, we married. She passed about 5 years ago. And then, I remarried. This lady, she's from Philadelphia. She loves sports. We did a lot of bowling and everything. We live over in Jersey now, down in Willingboro,
